household.applyToJoinHelp: Enter the ID of the household you want to join. The admin will need to approve your request.
household.applyToJoinHint: The admin can find their Household ID in their Settings page, or they can send you an invitation email directly.
household.categoriesHelp: The categories decide which shelf life the entry form suggests. They are shared across all household members.
household.categoryDaysAfterOpeningHelp: How long the product lasts after it was opened.
household.categoryShelfLifeHelp: How long the product lasts from the day it was bought.

household.createHouseholdHelp: Create a new household and switch to it. If you are currently the sole member, your products will be moved.
household.createNewWebhookHelp: Add a new endpoint to receive event payloads.
household.inviteHelp: Send an invitation to join this household. The recipient will receive an email with a magic link to accept.
household.languageHelp: Default language for members without their own preference and for notifications.
household.leaveHouseholdHelp: You will be assigned a new personal household. If you are the sole member, your products will be moved with you.
household.membersHelp: Manage household members. Change role, edit username or email, reset password, or remove.
household.monthlyWasteGoalHelp: Set a target your household aims to meet each month. Choose a maximum wasted count, a maximum waste percentage, or leave disabled.
household.secretTooShort: Secret must be at least 16 characters.
household.sentInvitationsHelp: Invitations you have sent. Cancelled invitations are hidden by default.
household.storageLocationsHelp: Locations are shared across all household members.
